cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)

# Generated by configure.py at /media/kudoyk/01s48/hairdesc_gpu/gpu-tutorial/apps/diffusion/configure.py
# Source yamls: app.yaml, implementations.yaml, machines/miyabi.yaml
# Config: variant=C++/stdpar/auto.def machine=miyabi mode=uni compiler=nvhpc
# DO NOT EDIT — re-run configure.py to regenerate.

# Compilers (must be set before project())
set(CMAKE_C_COMPILER "nvc")
set(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER "nvc++")
set(CMAKE_Fortran_COMPILER "nvfortran")

project(diffusion LANGUAGES CXX)

# Cache variables (override via -DFP=64 etc.)
set(FP "32" CACHE STRING "Floating point bits (32 or 64)")
set(NTHREADS "128" CACHE STRING "Threads (for omp-target/openacc opt variant)")

# Per-language compile flags
set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "-tp=native -O3 -I. -Wall -Minfo=accel,opt,mp -std=c++17 -stdpar=gpu -gpu=mem:unified:nomanagedalloc")

# Defines (compile-time macros)
add_compile_definitions(FP=${FP} BENCHMARK_MODE)

# Include dirs
include_directories(".")

# Link flags (parallel + memory model, etc.)
add_link_options(-stdpar=gpu -gpu=mem:unified:nomanagedalloc)

# Target
add_executable(diffusion src/misc.cpp src/diffusion.cpp src/main.cpp)
set_target_properties(diffusion PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME "diffusion.uni.${FP}")
target_link_libraries(diffusion PRIVATE -lm)
